d: Tensions have escalated in Pakistan-occupied Kashmir (PoK) as protests against the Pakistani government and authorities continue. Amid demonstrations, the Pakistan Army has reportedly launched a crackdown, with allegations of drones flying over residential areas and indiscriminate firing on protesters. According to reports, at least seven people have been killed in the violence. The situation has raised serious concerns over civilian safety, human rights violations, and the growing unrest in the region. What triggered the protests?
